extras: If Auto Folder Collapse is installed, disable it, as both plugins control the same tree.
intentEvidence: It is a derivative of Auto Folder Collapse: the accordion and inactivity behaviour of the original plugin are preserved
problem: Users often struggle to find the active note in a deep or complex file structure due to excessive scrolling and folder nesting.

relations.evidence: This project is derived from Auto Folder Collapse by Dario Casciato

summary: Folder Focus Collapse keeps the file explorer focused on the active note by collapsing surrounding folders and anchoring the active file in view.
